findings.title: Cron comparison prevents recovery by rerunning the cutover
findings.description: `production_changes()` strips new arguments only from `new`. After cron installation, a rerun captures the already-updated file as `old`, so identical cron files compare as different and step 4 fails. This blocks the documented recovery path for failures in later steps. Normalize both sides and add a post-installation rerun regression test.

findings.title: Failed health commands can pass using stale results
findings.description: `run_health()` ignores the command result and reads the existing log’s last line without checking that this invocation appended it. If execution or log redirection fails, an earlier clean summary can incorrectly pass the health gates. Require fresh log evidence and distinguish expected unhealthy results from execution failures.

findings.title: Host I/O failures bypass the promised failure report
findings.description: Only `StepFailed` and `CalledProcessError` are handled. File reads, `arm.touch()`, or a missing executable can raise `OSError`, escaping before `main()` writes the report. Handle these failures at the process boundary and ensure completed-step evidence is written on failure. Add coverage for a host I/O exception.
